scoreRanges.label: Low
scoreRanges.description: The score indicates minimal or no cognitive distortions. Your thinking appears healthy and balanced, with a good ability to handle emotional and social challenges.

scoreRanges.label: Moderate
scoreRanges.description: There are some cognitive distortions that may occasionally affect your emotional well-being. You might notice negative thought patterns in certain situations, which can be improved through self-reflection or support.

scoreRanges.label: High
scoreRanges.description: The score suggests significant cognitive distortions affecting your daily life, relationships, or mental well-being. It may be helpful to consult a professional to address these patterns.

scoreRanges.label: Very High
scoreRanges.description: The score indicates severe cognitive distortions that may cause major emotional and social challenges. Seeking professional support is strongly advised to improve thought patterns and psychological well-being.
